stories.subject: Rick Ross
stories.update: Prosecutors dropped the felony battery-by-strangulation count for insufficient evidence; a misdemeanor domestic-violence battery count remains.

stories.subject: LL COOL J
stories.update: ROCK THE BELLS: THE RESIDENCY is an 11-show Las Vegas run beginning May 15, 2027, at Dolby Live at Park MGM and continuing through July.

stories.subject: Hype Williams
stories.update: The director will receive the ToruńCAMERIMAGE Award for Achievements in Music Video in person in Poland in November 2026.

stories.subject: Takeoff estate
stories.update: Takeoff’s mother and estate filed a motion seeking terminating sanctions and dismissal of a civil sexual-assault lawsuit over alleged deleted text messages; the hearing is set for January 21, 2027.

stories.subject: Rockstar Games / Grand Theft Auto VI
stories.update: Rockstar explained a Criminal Profile system that ranges from Professional to Irredeemable and can affect reactions and story outcomes.
